summary_md: **Telasian Labs ([@Telasian](https://x.com/Telasian/status/2115459416245882918))** covers Tencent Hunyuan's **UserSWE**, which tests 11 coding agents on 72 multi-turn bug fixes with a simulated user; rankings change with turn budget (Claude Fable 5.1 best at one turn with 31.9%, GPT-6-Astra best by turn 8 with 81.9%).
